measurement: Successful operation compute CPU summed over all cuts and both directions per reaction. Mapping includes final family deduplication. Catalogue loading and lazy decoder assembly/export are inside compute. Result publication, verification and failed attempts are excluded from the primary distributions.
decoder_version: Frozen full campaign before decoder preparation repair dd0efeb; not a measurement of the latest decoder.
quantiles: Median averages the two middle values for an even sample; p90/p95/p99 use the empirical nearest-rank quantile.
